title: द्विनवत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 292 · Kunti casts her son adrift

summary.en: Kunti secretly bears a radiant son clad in armour and earrings. Afraid of discovery, she places him in a basket and sets him adrift on the river Ashva, lamenting and blessing him as she lets him go.
summary.kn: ಕುಂತಿ ರಹಸ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕವಚ ಕುಂಡಲಧಾರಿಯಾದ ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ ಮಗನನ್ನು ಹೆರುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಬಯಲಾಗುವ ಭಯದಿಂದ ಅವನನ್ನು ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟು ಅಶ್ವನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೇಲಿಬಿಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಬಿಡುವಾಗ ವಿಲಪಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಆಶೀರ್ವದಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: कुन्ती गुप्त रूप से कवच-कुण्डलधारी एक दीप्त पुत्र को जन्म देती हैं। भेद खुलने के भय से वे उसे एक पिटारी में रखकर अश्व नदी में बहा देती हैं, और विदा करते समय विलाप करती हुई उसे आशीर्वाद देती हैं।
summary.te: కుంతి రహస్యంగా కవచకుండలధారి అయిన తేజస్వి కుమారుని కంటుంది. బయటపడతానేమోనని భయంతో అతనిని పెట్టెలో ఉంచి అశ్వనదిలో తేలవిడుస్తుంది, వదులుతూ విలపిస్తూ ఆశీర్వదిస్తుంది.
summary.ta: குந்தி ரகசியமாகக் கவச குண்டலங்கள் அணிந்த ஒளிமிக்க மகனைப் பெறுகிறாள். வெளிப்பட்டுவிடுமோ என்று அஞ்சி அவனை ஒரு பேழையில் வைத்து அஶ்வ நதியில் மிதக்கவிட்டு, விடும்போது புலம்பியபடி ஆசீர்வதிக்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: രഹസ്യമായി കുന്തി കവചവും കുണ്ഡലങ്ങളുമണിഞ്ഞ തേജസ്വിയായ ഒരു പുത്രനെ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നു. കണ്ടുപിടിക്കപ്പെടുമോ എന്ന ഭയത്താൽ അവൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഒരു കുട്ടയിലാക്കി അശ്വനദിയിൽ ഒഴുക്കിവിടുന്നു; വിലപിച്ചും അനുഗ്രഹിച്ചും അവനെ പറഞ്ഞയക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.292; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो गर्भः समभवत्पृथायाः पृथिवीपते ।
शुक्ले दशोत्तरे पक्षे तारापतिरिवाम्बरे ॥

meaning.en: Then Pritha conceived, lord of earth, like the moon in the sky in the bright fortnight, on the tenth after.

verses.text:
सा बान्धवभयाद्बाला तं गर्भं विनिगूहती ।
धारयामास सुश्रोणी न चैनां बुबुधे जनः ॥

meaning.en: Out of fear of her relatives the girl concealed the pregnancy and carried it, and no one noticed her.

verses.text:
न हि तां वेद नार्यन्या काचिद्धात्रेयिकामृते ।
कन्यापुरगतां बालां निपुणां परिरक्षणे ॥

meaning.en: No woman knew of it except one nurse, skilled in guarding, who attended the girl in the maidens' quarters.

verses.text:
ततः कालेन सा गर्भं सुषुवे वरवर्णिनी ।
कन्यैव तस्य देवस्य प्रसादादमरप्रभम् ॥

meaning.en: In time the fair lady, still a maiden, by that god's grace bore a child shining like an immortal.

verses.text:
तथैव बद्धकवचं कनकोज्ज्वलकुण्डलम् ।
हर्यक्षं वृषभस्कन्धं यथास्य पितरं तथा ॥

meaning.en: He was born armored and had gold-bright earrings, lion-eyed, bull-shouldered, like his father.

verses.text:
जातमात्रं च तं गर्भं धात्र्या संमन्त्र्य भामिनी ।
मञ्जूषायामवदधे स्वास्तीर्णायां समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: As soon as he was born, the lady took counsel with the nurse and laid the baby in a basket, well padded on every side.

verses.text:
मधूच्छिष्टस्थितायां सा सुखायां रुदती तथा ।
श्लक्ष्णायां सुपिधानायामश्वनद्यामवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: In a smooth, comfortable basket coated with wax and well covered, weeping, she let it go in the river Ashva.

verses.text:
जानती चाप्यकर्तव्यं कन्याया गर्भधारणम् ।
पुत्रस्नेहेन राजेन्द्र करुणं पर्यदेवयत् ॥

meaning.en: Though she knew that a girl's pregnancy was improper, king, out of love for her son she lamented piteously.

verses.text:
समुत्सृजन्ती मञ्जूषामश्वनद्यास्तदा जले ।
उवाच रुदती कुन्ती यानि वाक्यानि तच्छृणु ॥

meaning.en: Listen to the words Kunti spoke, weeping, when she set the basket in the water of the Ashva.

verses.text:
स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्वान्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यश्च पुत्रक ।
दिव्येभ्यश्चैव भूतेभ्यस्तथा तोयचराश्च ये ॥

meaning.en: Good fortune to you, my son, from beings of the air and earth, from divine beings, and from all those that move in the water.

verses.text:
शिवास्ते सन्तु पन्थानो मा च ते परिपन्थिनः ।
आगमाश्च तथा पुत्र भवन्त्वद्रोहचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: May your paths be auspicious and no obstacles stand in your way, and may every approach to you, son, have minds free of hostility.

verses.text:
पातु त्वां वरुणो राजा सलिले सलिलेश्वरः ।
अन्तरिक्षेऽन्तरिक्षस्थः पवनः सर्वगस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: May King Varuna protect you in the water, lord of waters, and the wind that pervades all protect you in the sky.

verses.text:
पिता त्वां पातु सर्वत्र तपनस्तपतां वरः ।
येन दत्तोऽसि मे पुत्र दिव्येन विधिना किल ॥

meaning.en: May your father, the burning sun, best of the burners, protect you everywhere, by whom you were given to me, son, by a divine ordinance.

verses.text:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे च देवताः ।
मरुतश्च सहेन्द्रेण दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, Maruts with Indra, and the directions with their guardians,

verses.text:
रक्षन्तु त्वां सुराः सर्वे समेषु विषमेषु च ।
वेत्स्यामि त्वां विदेशेऽपि कवचेनोपसूचितम् ॥

meaning.en: may all the gods protect you on level and uneven ground. I shall know you even in a foreign land by your armor.

verses.text:
धन्यस्ते पुत्र जनको देवो भानुर्विभावसुः ।
यस्त्वां द्रक्ष्यति दिव्येन चक्षुषा वाहिनीगतम् ॥

meaning.en: Fortunate, son, is your father, the god Surya, the radiant, who will see you with his divine eye as you float along the river.

verses.text:
धन्या सा प्रमदा या त्वां पुत्रत्वे कल्पयिष्यति ।
यस्यास्त्वं तृषितः पुत्र स्तनं पास्यसि देवज ॥

meaning.en: Fortunate is the woman who will take you as her son, at whose breast you will drink when thirsty, god-born child.

verses.text:
को नु स्वप्नस्तया दृष्टो या त्वामादित्यवर्चसम् ।
दिव्यवर्मसमायुक्तं दिव्यकुण्डलभूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: What dream has she seen who will take as her son you, with the radiance of the sun, with divine armor, adorned with divine earrings,

verses.text:
पद्मायतविशालाक्षं पद्मताम्रतलोज्ज्वलम् ।
सुललाटं सुकेशान्तं पुत्रत्वे कल्पयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: lotus-wide eyes, shining lotus-red palms, a fine forehead and fine hair?

verses.text:
धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुत्र त्वां भूमौ संसर्पमाणकम् ।
अव्यक्तकलवाक्यानि वदन्तं रेणुगुण्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: Fortunate those will be who see you creeping on the ground, babbling indistinct sweet words, covered in dust.

verses.text:
धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुत्र त्वां पुनर्यौवनगे मुखे ।
हिमवद्वनसंभूतं सिंहं केसरिणं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Fortunate those who will see you again in your youth, like a maned lion born in the Himalayan forest.

verses.text:
एवं बहुविधं राजन्विलप्य करुणं पृथा ।
अवासृजत मञ्जूषामश्वनद्यास्तदा जले ॥

meaning.en: Having lamented in many ways so piteously, king, Pritha then set the basket in the water of the Ashva.

verses.text:
रुदती पुत्रशोकार्ता निशीथे कमलेक्षणा ।
धात्र्या सह पृथा राजन्पुत्रदर्शनलालसा ॥

meaning.en: Weeping, tormented by grief for her son at midnight, the lotus-eyed Pritha, with the nurse, longing to see her son,

verses.text:
विसर्जयित्वा मञ्जूषां संबोधनभयात्पितुः ।
विवेश राजभवनं पुनः शोकातुरा ततः ॥

meaning.en: released the basket and, afraid of being discovered by her father, returned to the royal palace, afflicted with grief.

verses.text:
मञ्जूषा त्वश्वनद्याः सा ययौ चर्मण्वतीं नदीम् ।
चर्मण्वत्याश्च यमुनां ततो गङ्गां जगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: The basket went from the Ashva to the river Charmanvati, from Charmanvati to the Yamuna, and thence to the Ganga.

verses.text:
गङ्गायाः सूतविषयं चम्पामभ्याययौ पुरीम् ।
स मञ्जूषागतो गर्भस्तरङ्गैरुह्यमानकः ॥

meaning.en: From the Ganga it came to the city of Champa in the land of the Sutas, the child in the basket carried along by the waves.

verses.text:
अमृतादुत्थितं दिव्यं तत्तु वर्म सकुण्डलम् ।
धारयामास तं गर्भं दैवं च विधिनिर्मितम् ॥

meaning.en: That divine armor and earrings, arisen from nectar, held the child, who was divine and ordained by fate.
